International Applicants
The application priority date for international students is December 1, 2026. Please follow the instructions for applicants found on the University Graduate School’s “How to Apply” page to apply online.
Neither the general GRE nor the Biochemistry GRE subject exam are required prerequisites to apply. However, if you have taken these exams and wish to report your scores, you can do so in the "Academic Test Score Report" section of your application. Official results can be sent to Indiana University using the following codes:
Institution Code: 1324
Department Code: 0202
If your native language is not English, you are required to submit results from one of the following English language proficiency exams:
Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), with a minimum score of 79 (internet-based test).
International English Language Testing System (IELTS), with a minimum score of 6.5.
Complete international applications for graduate study should contain the following:
Application form (online)
Apply now
A 300-500 word Personal Statement regarding your current goals, plans for your professional career, and reasons for selecting a field of study (upload to online application)
Official results of the TOEFL (or IELTS)
Three letters of recommendation (uploaded online by recommenders)
Your CV or resume with a timeline that includes your teaching, research and/or industrial experiences; a publications list, and any college or professional honors and awards
An application fee of $70 USD
Academic transcripts from all undergraduate institutions attended must be uploaded with your online application. Official transcripts must be mailed to the following address upon offer of admission:
IU Office of International Services
International Admissions
Ferguson International Center
330 N. Eagleson Avenue
Bloomington, IN 47405
Every country has its own postsecondary education system. To help you understand if your degree is equivalent to a bachelor’s degree awarded in the United States, visit this link.
All applicants that are accepted into the program should respond no later than April 15, 2027 to the offer of admittance. After the deadline, promise of support can no longer be guaranteed.
